messages:
anya (Design): quick copy + a11y check for the help tooltip on the per-route config page. currently the little '?' icon has title 'Help' and tooltip 'Learn more'. feels vague in user tests.
mike (Product): yeah users weren't sure if it linked to docs or opened inline help. can we clarify?
tara (Frontend): implementation note: the icon is an <button> with aria-label='Help' and a small CSS tooltip on hover. screen readers get 'Help' only.
sam (a11y): problem: generic 'Help' gives no context. aria-label should describe the target, e.g., 'Rate limit help, opens inline details'. Also the tooltip content should be meaningful and keyboard accessible.
anya (Design): propose copy change: visible tooltip: 'Per-route rate limit — more info'. button aria-label: 'Open per-route rate limit help'. If it opens docs in a new tab, add 'opens in new tab' to the label.
mike (Product): good call. on this page it opens an inline drawer with examples, not a new tab. so aria-label should say 'Open per-route rate limit help, opens inline'.
tara (Frontend): i'll update the markup to use a real popover component (role='button' triggers role='dialog' with focus trap) instead of a CSS-only tooltip. that gives keyboard access and we can set aria-describedby to the popover body.
sam (a11y): ensure the popover uses aria-modal or role='dialog', focus moves to the popover on open, escape closes it, and focus returns to the help button. the tooltip text should be the same as the popover heading for consistency. also avoid redundant 'help' in the screen reader string.
anya (Design): microcopy suggestion for popover heading/body:
"Heading: Per-route rate limit
Body: Limit the number of requests routed to this model per minute. See examples below and a suggested default for common workloads."

Button (aria-label): "Open per-route rate limit help, opens inline"

Tooltip (hover): "Per-route rate limit — more info"

Button visible: just the '?' icon (no text).
mike (Product): add a tiny link at the bottom of the popover: 'Read full docs' that opens docs in a new tab. label it clearly and append '(opens new tab)'.
tara (Frontend): will implement popover, aria-describedby, focus return util, and add analytics event. PR planned today.
anya (Design): please update the copy table and Figma component for Icon / Help states. also mark the tooltip as non-interactive in design spec (popover is interactive).
ops-bot: reminder: update accessibility checklist item 7.2 for popovers.
sam (a11y): i'll validate with VoiceOver & NVDA once PR is up. thanks, team! :white_check_mark:
